response.text:
Here are some of the best budget-friendly face washes for oily skin available in India under ₹500, specifically formulated to manage excess sebum, unclog pores, and prevent breakouts.

The Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser controls sebum and clears pores using **salicylic acid and zinc**.

* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, LHA, and Zinc PCA[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=Cost%3A%20%E2%82%B9270%20%2F%20100%20ml.%20Key%20Ingredients%3A,PCA%2C%20panthenol%2C%20allantoin.%20Texture%3A%20Lightweight%20gel%20cleanser.)
* **Best For:** Deep pore cleansing and acne control

The Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash relies on **antioxidant-rich green tea and glycolic acid** to gently exfoliate and balance oil.

* **Key Ingredients:** Green Tea Extracts and Glycolic Acid[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/top-10-face-wash-in-india#:~:text=The%20hypo-allergic%20formulation%20works%20as%20an%20everyday,excess%20oil%20and%20impurities%20from%20the%20skin.)
* **Best For:** Refreshing daily oil control[findingmadeeasy.com](https://findingmadeeasy.com/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-india/#:~:text=%F0%9F%91%89%20Best%20for%3A%20Daily%20use%20on%20oily,Refreshing%20feel.%20*%20Suitable%20for%20daily%20use.)

The Foxtale Oil & Acne Control Face Wash uses a blend of **salicylic acid and niacinamide** to regulate sebum production without stripping moisture.

* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, 1% Niacinamide, and Cica
* **Best For:** Calming redness and shine-free skin

The CeraVe Foaming Cleanser For Normal To Oily Skin features a **barrier-restoring formula** designed to cleanse excess oil while maintaining skin hydration.

* **Key Ingredients:** Ceramides, Niacinamide, and Hyaluronic Acid[www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/oily-skin-face-wash-and-cleanser#:~:text=%E2%82%B9349.%2019%25%20OFF.%20Get%20Free%20Gift*%20SELECT,BAG.%20*%20AD.%204.6.%20The%20Derma%20co.)
* **Best For:** Oily and sensitive skin types

The The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Wash targets breakouts and excess oils effectively with a **potent active combination**.

* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid and 2% Niacinamide
* **Best For:** Controlling active acne and blemishes[findingmadeeasy.com](https://findingmadeeasy.com/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-india/#:~:text=%F0%9F%91%89%20Best%20for%3A%20Pimples%20%26%20acne.%20Why,Controls%20oil%20effectively.%20*%20Improves%20skin%20texture.)

The Himalaya Neem Purifying Face Wash is a **herbal budget option** that clears impurities using traditional purifying extracts.

* **Key Ingredients:** Neem and Turmeric
* **Best For:** Natural, everyday cleansing on a budget[findingmadeeasy.com](https://findingmadeeasy.com/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-india/#:~:text=%F0%9F%91%89%20Best%20for%3A%20Everyday%20cleansing.%20Why%20we,*%20Good%20oil%20control.%20*%20Simple%20formula.)

The Chemist at Play Acne Control Face Wash comes with a **built-in silicone brush applicator** to deeply clear out trapped dirt and sebum.

* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, Azelaic Acid, and Cica
* **Best For:** Deep-cleansing blackheads and pores

The mCaffeine Naked & Raw Coffee Face Wash cleanses the skin with **pure Arabica coffee** to clear oil without causing tightness.

* **Key Ingredients:** Pure Coffee and White Water Lily
* **Best For:** Energizing and refreshing dull skin
